description: Deletes a note from a contact's card outright, as the note's Delete does. It cannot be undone (the activity log keeps what it said). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat after the note is gone answers success.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_client_note
title: Delete a client note
